topics.title: Holy Spirit
topics.description: The Breath of God, the Comforter, and the One through whom believers are born again — the least understood Person of the Holy Trinity.

topics.title: Seven Spirits of God
topics.description: The seven lamps of fire burning before the throne in Revelation 4:5 and the sevenfold Spirit described in Isaiah 11:2.

topics.title: Lady Wisdom
topics.description: The Woman who calls herself Wisdom and Understanding in Proverbs — present with God before creation, the architect at His side.

topics.title: Tree of Life
topics.description: From the garden of Eden to the river of the water of life in Revelation 22: Scripture's oldest symbol of eternal life.

topics.title: Bride of Christ
topics.description: The Church as the Bride made ready for the marriage supper of the Lamb, born of the Spirit and betrothed to the Son.

topics.title: New Jerusalem
topics.description: The holy city coming down from God out of heaven — its gates, foundations, river and throne, and the Jerusalem which is above.

topics.title: Holy Trinity
topics.description: One God made manifest through three distinct Persons — the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit — equal in Godhood, distinct in office.

topics.title: Biblical Symbolism
topics.description: The dove, the hen, the eagle, the menorah, the burning bush, the flaming sword — the images through which Scripture teaches.

topics.title: Book of Revelation
topics.description: The throne, the seven lamps, the seven churches, the Bride, and the new heaven and new earth.

topics.title: Genesis
topics.description: Creation, the image of God, Eden, the first family, and the way of the Tree of Life guarded by a flaming sword.

topics.title: Proverbs
topics.description: Solomon's wisdom literature, and the voice of Wisdom crying in the streets and building her house of seven pillars.

topics.title: Apocrypha & Historical Texts
topics.description: Texts such as the Wisdom of Solomon and 2 Esdras, printed in the 1611 King James Bible and read by Christians for centuries.

topics.title: Early Christianity
topics.description: The creeds, the Church Fathers, and early Christian witnesses on the Trinity and the Holy Spirit.

topics.title: Temple & Menorah
topics.description: The tabernacle lampstand shaped like an almond tree, kept burning continually before the Holy of Holies.

topics.title: Salvation
topics.description: Spiritual rebirth, the free gift of grace through faith in Jesus Christ, and the way back to the Father.

topics.title: Heaven & Resurrection
topics.description: Where the righteous dwell — Abraham's bosom, the present heavenly paradise, the resurrection, and the new creation.

topics.title: Biblical Language Studies
topics.description: Hebrew, Greek, and Aramaic words behind our English Bibles: ruach, pneuma, paracletos, gennao, chokmah and more.

topics.title: Theology
topics.description: Doctrine examined carefully: ontology and economy, the creeds, and the relationship between Scripture and tradition.
